testsuite.name: com.slotting.admin.account.AuthoritativeAccountAndSupportContractTest

testcase.name: Scenario 8: Account closure under active legal hold remains held without remote deletion
Scenario 11: Backend / session failure returns 503 without local fabrication
Scenario 7: Positive balance without settlement acknowledgment returns 422
Scenario 9: Clean account closure marks CLOSED, produces server receipt, survives restart
Scenario 6: Account closure with in-flight pending operations enters PENDING_SETTLEMENT
Scenario 5: Support case list and single read with cross-owner IDOR protection
Scenario 1: Authenticated player queries own profile with masked PII and KYC summary
Scenario 2: Unauthenticated returns 401; Foreign player requesting other profile returns 403
Scenario 3: Account statement returns double-entry ledger entries and running balances
Scenario 10: Consolidated RG summary truthfully reflects restrictions and limits
Scenario 4: Durable support case creation; replay idempotent; conflict on altered payload
